neighbours.label: the piece 'uch' in "inasmuch" / "insomuch"
fire: The ruling is significant, inasmuch as it overturns decades of precedent.
We are responsible, inasmuch as we failed to warn the residents.
The plan was a success inasmuch as nobody was hurt.
The crowd grew violent, insomuch that the guards fled the gate.
Inasmuch as you have asked, I will tell you the truth about it.
Her report is useful inasmuch as it collects the raw figures in one place.
The rain fell for weeks, insomuch that the river burst its banks.
He is guilty inasmuch as he knew of the fraud and stayed silent.
quiet: The ruling is significant, because it overturns decades of precedent.
We are responsible, insofar as we failed to warn the residents.
The plan was a success since nobody was hurt.
The crowd grew violent, so much that the guards fled the gate.
Since you have asked, I will tell you the truth about it.
Her report is useful in that it collects the raw figures in one place.
The rain fell for weeks, so that the river burst its banks.
He is guilty to the extent that he knew of the fraud and stayed silent.
